sentences.text: 2. At the very outset, learned counsel for the applicants prays for permission to withdraw this bail application on behalf of the applicants Praveen Jha and Jayhind Jha.
3. Accordingly, this anticipatory bail application under Section 438 of Cr.P.C. filed on behalf of the applicants Praveen Jha and Jayhind Jha is dismissed as withdrawn and not pressed.
4. As per the prosecution case, Sapna Jha whose marriage was performed with Prabal Jha on 11.5.2018, committed suicide by hanging herself.

It was alleged by the mother, brother and other witnesses that Sapna was being harassed and tortured by the husband and present applicants who are elder brother of husband of the deceased and sister-in-law, in connection with demand of Rs.2 Lac for construction/ repairing of the house.
5. Learned counsel for the applicant- Smt. Sangeeta has submitted that applicant is innocent.
She has not committed any offence.
She has been falsely implicated.
She is wife of Jayhind, elder brother of the husband of deceased.
She is living separately and she never demanded any dowry or never tortured or harassed deceased as she is also daughter in law of the same house.
It is submitted that applicant is lady and blessed with minor children.
It is further submitted that in her life time deceased never made any complaint against the present applicant about harassment or torture in connection with demand of dowry.
She is women with no criminal background.
Therefore, it is prayed that applicant may be released on anticipatory bail.
6. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed grant of anticipatory bail to the applicant.
7. Applicant is a woman and sister in law of the deceased.

Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case including the fact that she is mother of one minor child and there is no one to take care of her child, but without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I am of the view that it is a case in which she may be released on anticipatory bail.
Consequently, this first anticipatory bail application under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of anticipatory bail filed on behalf of applicant stands partly allowed.

8. It is directed that in the event of arrest applicant - Smt. Sangeeta be released on bail on her furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs. 50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Authority.
